entries.name: The Magical Underground
entries.content: The Magical Underground is a hidden network of supernatural beings scattered throughout New York. Invisible to ordinary humans, it thrives in back‐alley speakeasies, enchanted markets, and underground clubs. Hybrids, elves, demons, and other magical creatures gather here to share resources, evade scrutiny, and celebrate their mysterious identities.

entries.name: The Stillflame Assembly
entries.content: The Stillflame Assembly is a secretive human organization dedicated to identifying and controlling magical beings. Operating covertly, they monitor suspicious magical activity and work to keep the public unaware of the supernatural world. Armed with cursed weapons and black-market relics, they pose a serious threat to magical communities and rumors claim they’ve targeted A0N’s bar as a haven for “abominations.”

entries.name: Rook
entries.content: Rook is a lean, gray‐furred wolf‐shifter with a sharp tongue and a knack for brewing illegal potions. He competes with A0N for customers and influence while running a rival downtown establishment. Rumored to have ties to The Stillflame Assembly.

entries.name: Galena Stormtail
entries.content: Galena Stormtail is a savvy half-fae merchant who deals in exotic magical ingredients. She’s often found near hidden markets, selling spell components, rare herbs, and charmed metals. Friendly but cunning, she helps A0N secure fresh goods for his culinary experiments at a price, of course.

entries.name: The Howling Den
entries.content: The Howling Den is a hidden bar nestled within the Magical Underground and is run by A0N.  The establishment has become a popular haunt for supernatural patrons looking for top-notch food, potent brews, and a welcoming space to mingle safely.

entries.name: Old Borough Market
entries.content: Concealed beneath a rundown subway station, Old Borough Market is a supernatural bazaar where beings trade and form alliances. Here, curiosities from bottled nightmares to enchanted grains serve as prime ingredients for culinary magicians like A0N.

entries.name: Derek McAllister
entries.content: Derek McAllister, known as the Shadow Stalker, is a feared shifter specializing in silent, shadow-based assassinations. Cold and calculating, he serves the highest bidder and moves unseen, leaving no trace behind.

entries.name: Fur and Fang Bodybuilding Gym
entries.content: An underground gym tucked away beneath a rundown laundromat, it’s a safe haven where werewolves, hybrids, and other magically gifted, physically inclined beings train in secret. Known for its discreet nature, the gym hosts a variety of patrons, among them A0N, who works on his impressive physique in private away from human eyes.

entries.name: Alabaster Serpents
entries.content: Alabaster Serpents are a secretive race of snake creatures known for their extensive knowledge network and cunning negotiations. They dwell in the shadows of the New York City underground, trading secrets and information between various factions of the supernatural community. Their serpentine charm and cold demeanor strike fear in those who dare to deceive them.

entries.name: Max
entries.content: Max is an enthusiastic, competitive bodybuilder and regular at A0N’s bar. He admires A0N’s impressive physique and often challenges him to arm wrestling matches. Though he can be overzealous, Max is fundamentally good-hearted, his rivalry with A0N is laced with mutual admiration and an undercurrent of friendship.

entries.name: Dominus Nocturnum
entries.content: Dominus Nocturnum is a feared and enigmatic BDSM demon who rules The Crimson Chains—a decadent, hedonistic nightclub hidden in New York’s supernatural district. He wields sexually supernatural powers to manipulate both human and magical patrons, binding them in dark pacts and addictive desires through themes of bondage, fetish, and forbidden pleasure.

entries.name: Memory-Mending Charms
entries.content: Small talismans sold in secret corners of the Magical Underground that enable supernaturals to obscure, alter, or remove human memories of magical encounters. Although essential for those risking exposure, they are costly to buy.

entries.name: Marcus Greenfield
entries.content: Marcus Greenfield is a famous, muscular MMA fighter known for his aggressive nature and open disdain for magical creatures. He uses his renown to spread anti-supernatural sentiment and once unwittingly stirred tension at The Howling Den when patrons recognized him.

entries.name: Iggy
entries.content: Iggy is an tall purple lion with a thick white mane and a scar near his right eye. He boasts a massive, muscular build and wears a sleeveless black leather jacket featuring a yellow lightning emblem, a pink tank top, and tight black pants. In A0N’s early days, Iggy transformed him through fitness and continues to inspire others. As a demon, he can hypnotize and project idealized versions of himself while remaining kind-hearted. He shares a deep and occasionally intimate bond with A0N.
